name: chrome-remote-debugging
title: Chrome Remote Debugging
description: Automatically click Chrome's "Allow remote debugging?" prompt while the tool is open.
author: AceroM

commands.name: status
commands.title: Remote Debugging Status
commands.subtitle: Chrome Remote Debugging
commands.description: Open the menu bar tool and automatically keep the auto-allow watcher running until you quit.

commands.name: start
commands.title: Open Remote Debugging Auto-Allow
commands.subtitle: Chrome Remote Debugging
commands.description: Open or reopen the tool and start auto-allowing prompts.

commands.name: quit
commands.title: Quit Remote Debugging Auto-Allow
commands.subtitle: Chrome Remote Debugging
commands.description: Quit the watcher and hide its menu bar icon until you reopen the tool.

preferences.name: interval
preferences.title: Poll Interval (seconds)
preferences.description: How often to look for the prompt.
